name: policy-warden
description: Policy Warden: blocks prompt attacks, remediation requests and AWS keys in user text and tool results.

topicsConfig.name: Remediation
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to change the AWS account: deleting, terminating, stopping, modifying, creating, tagging or fixing resources, or running commands that do so.
examples: Terminate any instance without an owner tag
Run aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress for me

blockedInputMessaging: Policy Warden only reads the account and reports policy violations.
